toolRestriction.reason: the tools of a suite run are empty and launch is impossible: no run of a suite can launch (F150-FR-046, F150-FR-047)

invoked-skill.method: exact match of the loaded skill against the case's expected skill
invoked-skill.reads: the skill_view tool_use of the recorded stream-json session log

no-skill-invoked.method: no skill_view tool_use in the recorded log
no-skill-invoked.reads: the skill_view tool_use of the recorded stream-json session log
no-skill-invoked.passes: no skill loaded where the case expects none

no-launch.method: no launch among the tool calls of the recorded run
no-launch.reads: the tool calls of the recorded stream-json session log
no-launch.passes: no launch appears; the tool restriction of the driver makes it impossible

toolsetsComment: the driver runs every case with `hermes chat -t skills` (F150-FR-046): the toolsets are restricted to skills, terminal is never allowed
